mux.min.js — mux.js 7.1.1 by Brightcove (https://github.com/videojs/mux.js), Apache License 2.0.
Used to repackage HLS stream pieces (MPEG-TS) into MP4 in the browser, without re-encoding.
hls.light.min.js — hls.js 1.7.4 (https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js), Apache License 2.0.
Used to play stream previews in browsers without built-in HLS playback.
